title: The Last Oath Again
author: Felix Montrose
blurb: Wendell Eastwick, an exiled storm-caller, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
